newsitem.title: UK: Classic FM wins new FM licence in S Africa.
newsitem.headline: Classic FM wins new FM licence in S Africa.

text.p: British radio operator GWR Group Plc said on Friday its Classic FM unit was part of a consortium that has been awarded one of three new FM licences in greater Johannesburg, South Africa.
In a statement GWR said Classic would own a 20 percent stake in the station in return for supplying show formats, musical databases, training and advice on programming and marketing.
The company is part of a consortium led by The Liberty Life Foundation, linked to insurer Liberty Life Association of Africa Ltd.
Under the terms of the deal, Classic FM will not make any financial outlay in the investment, but will be protected from the dilution of its shareholding.
"This enables GWR and Classic FM to learn the dynamics of a new market in a risk-free environment," it concluded.
